name: Cross-platform rumor-detection transfer benchmark
description: Consolidated structural artifact (12,229 event records, 12,060 unique events, 4 public corpora), frozen protocol documents (STEP, P1–P7), complete analysis code, all result files underlying the manuscript's tables and figures, the zero-shot LLM prompt, and the de-duplicated content-free call cache. SHA-256 checksums in SHA256SUMS. Source-post text is not redistributed; corpora remain under their original providers' terms.
